additional_concerns: Nodes node.1bf6918f69c6b37738daeb83, node.4e6a162c35678e9ddf17ad8e, node.ce439b1cf9ed8301fbb68f94 and node.ea4d19630f8cab09065b1909 implement preserved processing as a relief exclusion. The circular expressly preserves processing but does not expressly establish this equivalence. The exclusion and separate-processing interpretations remain unresolved pending the applicable FAQs and existing-process rules.
Node node.4d548f2e09bc36ef51212f64 excludes legacy applications from its question's scope; OUT_OF_SCOPE does not establish substantive disqualification.

The introduction refers to immediate effect, while the implementation provision specifies 28 November 2025 for measures in the FAQs. That date supports the proposed commencement assumption but does not resolve the legally decisive event or subsequent approval, withdrawal and resubmission cases.

Item (ii) expressly requires home-jurisdiction compliance. The introductory reference to home supervision does not clearly establish an additional independent eligibility condition, particularly given item (i)'s express supervision requirement.
The supplied dependency IDs lack identity mappings and have null source hashes. They cannot safely be assigned to the FAQs, existing-process rules or home-jurisdiction requirements.

Fund classification, home compliance, materiality, novelty, complexity and possible local policy implications remain supplied judgments. The formulas do not determine those facts, notification compliance, post-vetting compliance or an independent approval obligation.
